'''Tijds''' is a soldier in [[Gareth Bryne]]'s army.

== Appearance ==
Tijds is a young man with neat, black hair.

== Activities ==
He reports to Bryne and [[Siuan Sanche]] about the [[Seanchan]] attacking the [[White Tower]].{{ref/book|12|40}}
